Inceptio

Before everything, there was chaos

"Chaos, a raw and undivided mass,
Naught but lifeless bulk, with warring seeds
Of ill-joined elements compressed together." Ovid, Metamorphoses, Book I, 1.9–11

As Ovid told it, chaos existed before everything — just as a blob of tangled thoughts precedes a full-fledged argument. This website is where that blob gets worked through: my representations, my observations and my experiences.
